name: How can I prepare my property for an eaves repair service?
description: Clear obstacles under the eaves and discuss concerns about delicate landscaping with the repair team. Provide access to water or electricity if needed.

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my property for an eaves repair service?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for an eaves repair service, it's helpful to clear the areas directly beneath the eaves of any obstacles such as patio furniture, plants, or decorative items. This provides our team with clear access and reduces the risk of damage to your belongings. If you have any concerns about specific landscaping or delicate features, discussing these with our team during the initial consultation can ensure they are properly protected. Providing easy access to water or electricity might also be beneficial for some repair processes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear obstacles under the eaves and discuss concerns about delicate landscaping with the repair team. Provide access to water or electricity if needed.
